tools.name: get_return_policy
tools.description:
Get return policy information for a specific product category.

Returns:
    Detailed return policy information for the specified category

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description:
Get detailed technical specifications for electronics products.

Returns:
    Detailed product specifications and features

laptop_results.get_return_policy:
Return Policy - Laptops:

- Return Window: 30 days
- Condition Requirements: Original packaging, all accessories included, no physical damage
- Return Process: Online RMA portal or in-store return
- Refund Timeline: 7-10 business days after inspection
- Shipping: Free return shipping for defects, customer pays for change of mind
- Warranty: 1-year manufacturer warranty, extended warranty available
- Restocking Fee: None for defects, 15% for change of mind

For assistance with returns, visit our online RMA portal or contact customer support.

cases.query: Look up the laptop product and return policy. Return only JSON with product (featured model name), return_window_days (integer), and approved (false). This is an information request, not a return authorization.
Look up the laptop return policy. Return only JSON with return_window_days (integer) and approved (false). Do not approve a return.
No product or policy lookup is needed. Reply with exactly this JSON: {"message":"Hello!","approved":false}
